title: Instance-local temporary state
trainingLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Move ownership from A to B and compare exact required artifact bytes and workflow checkpoints in instance-local versus simulated shared/durable storage; reject empty successful-looking responses.
preconditions: A browser with JavaScript and local sibling scripts/styles; no account or server.
Three fixed ASCII fixtures represent an upload, workflow checkpoint and generated export.
Durable mode is an in-memory shared-store teaching assumption, not persisted storage.
actions: Select artifact, storage and retrieval observation, then prepare on A.
Handoff ownership to empty B without copying local state.
Verify the artifact bytes, byte count, teaching checksum and workflow checkpoint.
Reset to defaults and an untested current run while retaining all recorded outcomes.
expectedAssertions: Shared/durable intact retrieval preserves exact bytes and checkpoint for all three artifacts.
Local state remains on A and becomes missing on serving owner B; HTTP-like 200 cannot hide loss.
Empty 200, same-length corruption and missing workflow checkpoint are explicit failures.
Unavailable observation is unknown, never success or known loss.
Strict inputs, phase guards, immutable snapshots and page-lifetime limits prevent destructive retries.
Keyboard reset preserves all prior results and lifetime budgets.

limits.retention: In-memory page lifetime only; reset retains history; reload clears the teaching model.
limits.concurrency: No concurrent writers or timing model.
